name: Monke Upgrade Tree
summary:
# Monke Upgrade Tree
(This game is currently in early-access! Please report any and all bugs to the Discord!)

Enter a calm and enjoyable experience in the new and original VR game: Monke Upgrade Tree.

- Buy upgrades and unlock new and exciting features as you expand your tree.
- Earn achievements as you progress, or by doing challenges.
- Play daily for extra rewards such as Coins and Cosmetics!
- Compete to be at the top of the leaderboards.

And most importantly...
 Have fun!
